Metadata.description: Guided breathwork, movement and awareness programs with Umberto Iglina.

hero.introLine1: My method. 20 years of clinical research.
hero.introLine2: Advanced training in Osteopathy, Kinesiology and Traditional Yoga.

items.title: Clinical Evidence
items.body: Every module draws on twenty years of therapeutic experience and biomechanical study of human movement. A rigorous, non-commercial approach in which every technique is explained through clinical reasoning.

items.title: Performance & Quality of Life
items.body: Advanced protocols designed to neuromodulate your body. Improve athletic performance by discovering new aspects of your physical system, learn to calm your mind in everyday life and under greater stress, and give yourself an authentic self-care experience.

items.title: Put Yourself Back at the Center
items.body: Combining the ancient science of breath from Traditional Yoga with osteopathic precision has a direct impact on posture, cardiovascular efficiency, systemic longevity and psychophysical wellbeing. Are you ready to develop your full potential?

about.name: Umberto Iglina
about.paragraph1: As an osteopath and human movement specialist, I have always looked for tools that could help my patients live better.
about.paragraph2: I have had the privilege of studying Yoga in its most authentic form, and I have been studying the science of breath for more than 20 years. By bringing ancient traditions together with a modern clinical approach, I discovered how we can create meaningful change in our lives. Welcome.

items.question: What is the method, and how does it combine science with Eastern disciplines?
items.answer: The approach combines the age-old benefits of Yoga and Breathwork with the precision of Osteopathy and biomechanics. Every technique is explained through clinical reasoning to provide concrete, measurable and lasting benefits.

items.question: Are the courses suitable for someone who has never practiced breathing techniques?
items.answer: Absolutely. The courses are progressive and can be adapted to your starting level, with step-by-step guidance for beginners and experienced practitioners alike.

items.question: I have postural issues or chronic pain. Can I take the courses?
items.answer: Yes. As an osteopath, I designed the movement flows with the body's anatomy and physiology in mind. For serious or acute conditions, always consult your doctor first.

items.question: How much time should I dedicate before I see results?
items.answer: Consistency matters more than volume. You will find 10–15 minute practices as well as complete 45–60 minute sessions. Even after your first Breathwork sessions, you may notice less stress and greater mental clarity.

items.question: What is the difference between recorded courses and live sessions?
items.answer: Recorded courses give you complete freedom to manage your time and revisit videos whenever you want. Live sessions offer direct interaction, specific questions and personalized feedback on posture and breathing rhythm.

items.question: What is Breathwork, and why is it clinically important?
items.answer: Breathwork is conscious work with the breath. Scientifically, it affects the autonomic nervous system, heart rate and cortisol. It is a form of neurobiological reprogramming that can improve energy, focus and systemic health.

items.question: I am a high-level athlete. How can the method improve my performance?
items.answer: The method works on three pillars: biomechanical and postural efficiency, regulation of the Autonomic Nervous System through rapid sympathetic/parasympathetic switching, and CO₂ tolerance to delay fatigue and maintain focus under maximal effort.

terms.title: Terms and conditions
terms.providerBody: Insert the seller’s full legal name, legal form, registered office, VAT or tax number, company register details where applicable, email, certified email and support contacts.
terms.purchaseBody: The contract concerns personal access to digital educational content. Before payment, the course, total price and applicable conditions are displayed; the order is concluded when Stripe confirms payment.
terms.paymentBody: Payment and billing information are managed by Stripe. The user receives electronic confirmation summarising the purchase and declarations made.
terms.accessBody: When expressly requested at checkout, access to the course starts immediately after payment confirmation. Access duration, supported devices and technical limitations must be specified in the final version.
terms.accountBody: The account and content are personal. Sharing credentials, copying, recording, redistributing or commercially using materials without permission is prohibited.
terms.liabilityBody: Content is educational and does not replace medical assessment or treatment. Add health warnings, limitations permitted by law, applicable law, complaint handling and support contacts.

privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.controllerBody: Insert the controller’s full identity and contact details, any data protection officer and the channel dedicated to privacy requests.
privacy.dataBody: The platform processes account, authentication, purchase, contractual consent, course progress and support data to provide the service, perform the contract, comply with legal obligations and protect the platform.
privacy.providersBody: Stripe manages payments and billing, Mux manages video streaming, Supabase hosts data and files, Resend sends transactional emails, and Vercel hosts the application. The final version must specify roles, legal bases, retention periods, transfers and provider privacy notices.
privacy.rightsBody: Describe contacts and procedures for access, rectification, erasure, restriction, objection, portability and complaints to the supervisory authority, including cases where data must be retained for legal obligations or legal claims.

withdrawal.title: Withdrawal and refunds
withdrawal.periodBody: Where applicable, a consumer may exercise the right of withdrawal within 14 days after the contract is concluded. The platform displays the online function only for purchases that remain eligible.
withdrawal.digitalBody: If, before payment, the consumer expressly requests immediate performance and acknowledges loss of the right of withdrawal, the ordinary 14-day withdrawal right ends when access to the digital content begins.
withdrawal.exerciseBody: Open purchase history, select an eligible order, provide your name and confirm the declaration. The system records date and time, sends confirmation to the account email and starts a refund to the original payment method.
withdrawal.defectsTitle: Content not supplied or not compliant
withdrawal.defectsBody: Waiver of withdrawal does not remove mandatory remedies for digital content that is not supplied or not compliant. Add final support contacts, reporting procedure, response times and applicable remedies.
